connector.name: Alloy by alloy.cx
connector.registryDescription: AI workspace - shared knowledge, skills, and tools for AI agents
connector.summary: Hosted at api.alloy.cx over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace cx.alloy, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
